_comment: Hand-reviewed club families for the team search (#133; docs/data-api.md, 'Team directory'). TGS lists some clubs under several club ids; a family shows them as one club in the search dropdown. An entry is {"name": shown name, "main": the club id whose logo and place stand for the family, "clubIDs": [two or more TGS club ids], "evidence": why they are one club}. Declared by the SWE with evidence and approved by the Reviewer and the owner in a PR, like team-links.json; never from a visitor's request alone. team_directory.py validates every entry on every build (known integer ids, never club 7, an id in one family only, main among the ids, no other keys); an entry that fails is left out and reported (the run fails, the directory is still written).

families.name: PDA
families.evidence: Owner-approved for #133 (2026-10-01). TGS lists PDA under four club ids, all in New Jersey, and every team of each is named 'PDA ...': 2357 'PDA Blue (North)', Somerset (teams 'PDA Blue'); 3313 'PDA White (Shore)', Hamilton (teams 'PDA White'); 2628 'PDA South', Westampton (teams 'PDA South'); 78 'Players Development Academy', Somerset (the earlier id of the 'PDA White' teams). Main 2357: PDA's Somerset home, the place of the earlier academy id too; 2357 and 3313 tie on current teams (6 each).
